name: @kdl/framework-monorepo
description: KDL Landing Framework — Software Operating System Monorepo

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @kdl/bootstrap build && pnpm --filter @kdl/inspiration build && pnpm --filter @kdl/ai-director build && pnpm --filter @kdl/builder build && pnpm --filter @kdl/reviewer build && pnpm --filter @kdl/orchestrator build && pnpm --filter @kdl/cli build
scripts.test: node --import tsx tests/e2e/e2e-pipeline.test.ts && pnpm --filter @kdl/orchestrator test && pnpm --filter @kdl/reviewer test && pnpm --filter @kdl/builder test && pnpm --filter @kdl/ai-director test && pnpm --filter @kdl/inspiration test && pnpm --filter @kdl/bootstrap test && pnpm --filter @kdl/cli test
scripts.typecheck: tsc --project packages/bootstrap/tsconfig.json && tsc --project packages/inspiration/tsconfig.json && tsc --project packages/ai-director/tsconfig.json && tsc --project packages/builder/tsconfig.json && tsc --project packages/reviewer/tsconfig.json && tsc --project packages/orchestrator/tsconfig.json && tsc --project packages/cli/tsconfig.json
